# Comfy AIrt MAchIne (API version)

Upload an image to generate a unique, looping AI video. The workflow uses an LLM to create prompts, employs Kling3.0 for video generation, and stitches the clips into a seamless final loop. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/templates_mjm_airt_machine_api.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.
